title: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A young Temur hunter who tends Tae Jin's wound and feels left out of her twin's shamanic training.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer who bonds with Tae Jin over shamanic training.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The former Temur chief, now called First Mother, who confronts Tae Jin and reveals she witnessed Bolas kill Ugin eighteen years ago.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A Jeskai ghostfire warrior whose mother was a scribe of Shu Yun and who recites Ugin's story on his master's orders.

entities.name: Fec
entities.description: An old orc hunter who warns of a dragon tempest and helps Yasova harvest the broodling.

entities.name: Mattak
entities.description: A hunter on sentry duty who asks Yasova to come see something.

entities.name: Oiyan
entities.description: A hunter assigned to sentry duty.

entities.name: Darka
entities.description: A quiet ainok hunter assigned to sentry duty.

entities.name: Rakhan
entities.description: A hunter who kindles a fire in the shelter.

entities.name: Sorya
entities.description: A hunter who hauls water for the shelter.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon, narrator of the story, who is betrayed by his twin and is flung between planes before landing on Tarkir.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin, who manipulates human leaders by whispers into a war of heirs and then claims their rule, and who later killed Ugin per Yasova.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: An elder dragon who takes human form to observe humans and recommends destroying the human chief; he flies off after rebuking Nicol.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: The twins' elder brother, a dragon ruling a human realm.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: A dragon whom Nicol wishes to take revenge on.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: The twins' sister whose skull and spine decorate human settlements.

entities.name: Te Ju Ki
entities.description: The human elder who taught Ugin about planes.

entities.name: The dragon-killer chief
entities.description: An old human chief who killed Merrevia Sal, rules by decreeing that dragon-killers become heirs, and is murdered by his second wife.

entities.name: The chief's son
entities.description: The neglected firstborn son of the chief, who killed a dragon and, goaded by Nicol's whispers, takes the throne.

entities.name: The chief's second wife
entities.description: The chief's second wife, a mage who first ensorcelled venom, who murders the chief and later marries and dies with the son.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: A leader of the Jeskai before the fall whom Tae Jin's mother served as scribe, who liked his secrets.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The Dragonlord who purged Jeskai knowledge.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The Dragonlord who killed Naiva and Baishya's mother for being a whisperer.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose hedrons held magic that preserved some essence of Ugin.

entities.name: Anchin
entities.description: Yasova's beloved animal, whose pelt is her mantle.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place and where Ugin lands after crossing the planes.

entities.name: The birth mountain
entities.description: The mountain where the twins hatched, surrounded by dragon-killer settlements.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: A chasm toward which the party is traveling to finish the story.

entities.name: Ghostfire warriors
entities.description: Jeskai warriors who wield spectral blades, supposedly doomed by a bargain.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The people and tradition Tae Jin belongs to.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: The dragons who rule Tarkir's clans and have outlawed the old ways.

entities.name: The Temur
entities.description: Yasova's former clan.

entities.name: Dragon tempest
entities.description: Storms that birth dragons, now growing stronger.

entities.name: The planes
entities.description: Other worlds that powerful individuals can walk between.

events.summary: Yasova demands the truth from Tae Jin after finding he is a ghostfire warrior, threatening to kill him.
events.quote: All our lives are forfeit if the dragons discover we have sheltered a ghostfire warrior.

events.summary: Tae Jin explains that his mother was a scribe of Shu Yun who survived Ojutai's purge and that his master taught him the ghostfire blade.
events.quote: She survived Ojutai's purge and dedicated herself to saving what she could of the history and knowledge of the Jeskai Way.

events.summary: Fec warns of an approaching dragon tempest, and the party shelters in a rock chamber.
events.quote: It's a dragon tempest, and it's moving in fast,

events.summary: Naiva tends Tae Jin's wound and learns he left his mother at twelve; she reveals Atarka killed her own mother for being a whisperer.
events.quote: Our mother is dead. Atarka killed her for being a whisperer.

events.summary: Tae Jin argues that keeping the old ways alive defies the dragons, and Naiva realizes she was wrong.
events.quote: By keeping them alive, we defy the dragons rather than accept defeat.

events.summary: Yasova asks Tae Jin to resume his story of Ugin and Nicol.
events.quote: There is more to your story. I'll listen.

events.summary: Flashback: Ugin and Nicol wait on the birth mountain overnight and see a lone traveler who proves to be Chromium Rhuell in human form.
events.quote: who appeared outwardly as a pregnant human except for the way his eyes shone like sapphires

events.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell describes the dragon-killing chief and his heirs and proposes destroying them; Nicol twists his words.
events.quote: My recommendation is that we destroy the chief, his heirs, and his acolytes, burn all the temples, and salt the fields.

events.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell, enraged by Nicol's twisting of words, reveals his true dragon form, belittles Nicol as the least of them, and flies away.
events.quote: You are the least of us, last fallen, not even a whole dragon but only half of one, bound as you are to Ugin.

events.summary: Flashback: The twins watch the chief's procession and temple; Ugin hears whispers about the heirs' rivalry.
events.quote: She intends to outlast you and have you throttled when he dies.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol identifies the chief's attendants as two of his four heirs and says it will be easy.
events.quote: Those two who attend him so assiduously are two of his heirs.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol kills a young messenger to stop word reaching the other heirs.
events.quote: he swooped down, caught up the youth in his claws and, as the young human screamed and struggled, bit off his head.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol whispers into the mind of the chief's son at a lakeside settlement, persuading him to march against the other heirs and kill his father.
events.quote: It could be your measure. If you march against the other heirs.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol marks the longhouse ridge and the son's warriors march off; Nicol explains humans are easy to manipulate through hate, envy and fear.
events.quote: Humans are riddled with hate and envy and fear and greed.

events.summary: Flashback: The chief's son seizes the central settlement, Nicol lures the other two heirs into a battle and burns the temple.
events.quote: Nicol flew down to the unguarded temple and burned it and its acolytes to the ground.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol deposits the old chief in the courtyard of his second wife, who has been whispered into rebellion; she kills him.
events.quote: She stabbed him once, twice, and thrice, and had his bloody, bloated body thrown into the stinking refuse of a latrine.

events.summary: Flashback: The son and the second wife are wed, then kill each other in a blood oath, and Nicol proclaims himself the humans' true leader.
events.quote: I rule you now. I am your true leader. Bow before me.

events.summary: Flashback: Ugin realizes Nicol caused the earlier murder and plans to manipulate his mind too, and he feels his twin's betrayal.
events.quote: He wanted to use me for his own ends, because he had never truly cared for me at all.

events.summary: Flashback: Ugin is torn into the space between planes and then lands on Tarkir.
events.quote: being torn from the only place I had never known and flung into the space between the planes.

events.summary: Tae Jin ends his story, and Yasova says she witnessed Ugin's death eighteen years ago and another dragon who vanished in golden light.
events.quote: Eighteen years ago, I witnessed a battle in the sky that ended with the death of Ugin.

events.summary: Yasova reveals Bolas killed Ugin and that she was used as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
events.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

events.summary: A dragon tempest breaks and Mattak asks Yasova to come see something.
events.quote: First Mother, you'd best come see.

relations.quote: This day is the wedding of the heirs of the dragon killer

relations.quote: my master received a vision nevertheless.
